scripts.main: bun build src/main.ts src/preload.ts --target=node --format=cjs --external electron --outdir dist --entry-naming [name].cjs
scripts.start: bun run --cwd ../web build && bun run main && electron .
scripts.prebuild: bun run --cwd ../web build && rm -rf build && mkdir build && cp -R ../web/dist build/web && cp -R ../server/drizzle build/drizzle && bun run server && bun run main
scripts.prerelease: bun run --cwd ../web build && rm -rf build && mkdir build && cp -R ../web/dist build/web && cp -R ../server/drizzle build/drizzle && bun run server && bun run main
